tools.name: raisely_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Raisely API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/subscriptions/{uuid}/donations" or "/donations?limit=50". Returns the parsed JSON.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_authenticated_user" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, list_posts, list_orders · Private data: get_authenticated_user, list_tags, create_donation, upsert_user, update_profile · Public sink: create_donation, upsert_user, create_post · Destructive: update_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, list_posts, list_orders · Private data: get_authenticated_user, list_tags, create_donation, upsert_user, update_profile · Public sink: create_donation, upsert_user, create_post · Destructive: update_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
